sources.snippet: The exponential growth of social media has created an urgent need for automated systems to analyze unstructured public sentiment in real time. This study compares a traditional Logistic Regression model using TF-IDF features with a deep learning Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) architecture on a 10,000-tweet subset of the Sentiment140 dataset. sources.snippet: More > AI hub. Select AI models. (Optional) To keep AI models permanently on the menu for easy access, select the pin icon. Select Sentiment analysis - Detect positive, negative, or neutral sentiment in text data. Select predefined text samples to analyze, or add your own text, select Analyze text to display how the model analyzes your text.
